text:
Maria L: Kicking off staged rollout for inference-service v2.3.1-canary. Plan: 5% -> 25% traffic at 03:10 UTC, bake window 20m. Watch p95 latency and error-rate. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/inf/v2-3-1

Jake R: saw a tiny uptick in EU latency during last canary at 5% (~15s ago). p95 +18ms, nothing huge but worth watching.

Olivia (oncall): can we hold increase until we validate requests/sec and tail errors? I can watch for 20m.

Kevin S: what are rollback thresholds? recommend: p95 > 200ms sustained 3m OR 5xx rate > 0.5% over 5m -> rollback. also watch kv-cache OOMs (last time we saw swap thrash).

deploy-bot: Deployment started: inference-service v2.3.1-canary -> canary pool. Current traffic: 5%.

Maria L: thanks. propose we re-evaluate at T+10 (03:20 UTC) and T+30. If signals look clean, proceed to 25%.

Jake R: request: pin current stable v2.3.0 on EU to avoid accidental shift during canary.

Olivia (oncall): +1 pin, reduces blast radius if autoscaling behaves oddly.

sre-ops: Command to pin: `rwctl rollout pin --service=inference-service --region=eu-west --version=v2.3.0` (will lock routing for region).

Kevin S: also adding temporary guardrail: disable burst-burst scaling for canary pool to keep utilization predictable.

Maria L: OK doing pin now, will delay 25% shift until we get green at T+10.

deploy-bot: Action: routing pin applied -> inference-service (eu-west) pinned to v2.3.0 by Maria L.

Jake R: I ran a quick smoke set against v2.3.1-canary, a couple of rerank responses had slightly different tokenization behavior. Not a blocker but note for release notes.

Olivia (oncall): Monitoring: setting alert rule to escalate if p50 increases > 30ms or p95 > 200ms.

sre-ops: FYI backend logs showed a single KV cache eviction spike at 03:04 UTC, correlates with small GC pause on host-12. No sustained OOM.

Maria L: Decision: hold at 5% for now, pin in EU, postpone 25% shift until further notice. If all clear by 03:20 we'll re-open and do a controlled 5->25 shift with telemetry on.

Kevin S: rollback plan ready: immediate traffic rollback to v2.3.0 in all regions + restart canary pool nodes if necessary. Command: `rwctl rollout shift --service=inference-service --to-version=v2.3.0 --immediate`

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Rollback playbook attached: /playbooks/rollbacks/inference_v2.json

Maria L: thanks team. I'll post a short release note snippet and update the runbook: "Held 5%->25% shift due to transient EU latency spike; pinned EU to v2.3.0; will re-evaluate at 03:20 UTC." :memo:

Olivia (oncall): I'll keep eyes on error budget and latency. Ping me @olivia if we want to force rollback.

Jake R: minor docs item for QA: note tokenization diff in release notes.

Maria L: closing thread for now. Follow-up at 03:20. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
